Title: Azure Event Grid on Azure IoT Edge preview 2 is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Event Grid on Azure IoT Edge preview 2 is now available. Updates include additional destination types, monitoring capabilities, and data plane persistence to disk.

Read the tutorials to forward edge events to Event Grid in the Azure cloud and to publish and subscribe to events using Event Grid on IoT Edge.

Learn how to enable persistence in Linux and Windows deployments, monitor topics and event subscriptions, and configure event handlers and destinations.

Read more in the Azure Event Grid on Azure IoT Edge release notes.
